text:
Bees are known to produce honey, beeswax, propolis, royal jelly, and bee pollen.

To start beekeeping as a hobby, you will need the following equipment and materials:
1. Beehive (typically Langstroth, Top-Bar, or Warre style)
2. Frames and foundation sheets
3. Beekeeping suit (jacket or full suit with veil)
4. Gloves
5. Smoker
6. Hive tool
7. Bee brush

Sourcing options include local agricultural supply stores, dedicated beekeeping suppliers, online retailers specializing in apiary equipment, and local beekeeping associations which often have member directories for recommended vendors.
